tools.name: scan_site
tools.title: Scan a website
tools.description: Open the real Busymate AI quick start for a website address, at busymate.ai/try/<host> — the same one-click scan and grounded assistant preview this page demonstrates. Opens in a new tab; does not scan inside this page.

url.description: A website address, with or without https://, e.g. 'acme.com' or 'https://acme.com'.

tools.name: list_examples
tools.title: List the pre-scanned examples
tools.description: List the three pre-scanned example sites on this page, with their live busymate.ai/try/<host> result URL.

tools.name: show_example
tools.title: Show a pre-scanned example
tools.description: Scroll to and highlight one of this page's three pre-scanned example sites (so a visitor can see its real result without typing anything), or open its live quick-start result in a new tab.

tools.name: get_readiness
tools.title: Score a website's AI-readiness
tools.description: Score ANY website's AI-readiness live — the same six-layer checker (llms.txt, agents.json, MCP, WebMCP, structured data, robots/sitemap) the quick start runs — through Beacon's own MCP server, so an agent can grade a site without leaving this page.

url.description: A website address, with or without https://, e.g. 'acme.com' or 'https://acme.com'.
